product.title: Full Day Excursion to Petrópolis from Rio de Janeiro

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this full-day excursion leaves the coast for Petrópolis, the former imperial summer capital in the Serra dos Órgãos. An accredited guide covers the Imperial Museum with the included ticket, then continues to Palácio Quitandinha and the Santos Dumont House. A buffet lunch is included; drinks, desserts, and optional Bohemia Brewery entry are listed separately on the product page. Round-trip transport uses an air-conditioned vehicle from a Rio de Janeiro hotel pickup or listed meeting point, with a published 8:00 a.m. start. The mountain day is aimed at visitors who want a guided imperial-history window without self-driving the serra road. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on the Imperial Museum, Palácio Quitandinha, and the Santos Dumont House that shape this Petrópolis outing rather than a Corcovado or Sugar Loaf city circuit.
